methodology: One primary category per selected catalog entry; counts sum to 482. Optional secondary categories overlap and are non-exhaustive.
These are catalog entries without a complete standalone port, not 482 failed proof attempts or 482 distinct peephole equations.
Plain internal forwards to separately inventoried helpers are bookkeeping. Semantic adapters, such as constrained FP intrinsic wrappers, retain the corresponding semantic category.
No proof outcome, implemented/proven count, counterexample count, or Lean artifact is changed by this classification.
Apparently unreachable source branches are source-inspection conclusions, not formal global unreachability proofs.

fp.label: Floating-point semantics
fp.description: Floating-point operations/intrinsics, NaNs, signed zero, rounding, exceptions and constrained FP behavior need modeled semantics.

recursive.label: Recursive and contextual simplification
recursive.description: Generic recursive simplifier correctness, composition of returned rewrites, and select-arm substitution soundness have not been formalized.

analysis.label: Certified analysis facts
analysis.description: KnownBits, ranges, dominance, assumptions, poison implication or decomposition facts need semantic certificates retained by Puddle validity.

bookkeeping.label: Forwarders and other catalog structure
bookkeeping.description: Internal forwarding calls, condition/eligibility helpers, apparently unreachable branches and outer guards do not supply independent local rewrite equations.

vector_aggregate.label: Vector and aggregate semantics
vector_aggregate.description: Vector/scalable/SVE, insert/extract, shuffle/interleave and overflow-result aggregate semantics are missing from the relevant interpreter.

pointer.label: Pointer and target-model limitations
pointer.description: Pointer provenance, DataLayout, constant expressions, cast interpretation and memory-dependent pointer identity need additional formal support.

undef.label: Undef semantics
undef.description: LLVM nondeterministic undef is not interpreted; this is distinct from the existing scalar poison semantics.

other_intrinsic.label: Other intrinsic semantics
other_intrinsic.description: Includes pdep/pext, scmp/ucmp, high-half multiplication and fixed-point multiplication intrinsics.

external_evaluation.label: External evaluators and memory/calls
external_evaluation.description: Generic external constant-folding contracts and global-memory/load/call/GC semantics need formal support.

phi.label: PHI and control-flow context
phi.description: Incoming-edge, predecessor and CFG semantics needed by PHI-based simplification are not modeled by local rewrite validity.

entries.description: For vector_splice_left/right, an undef offset yields poison of the result vector type.
entries.reason: vector_splice_left/right intrinsics are not modeled

entries.description: For vector_splice_left/right, return poison when known unsigned minimum offset exceeds the maximum possible vector element count; scalable count uses function vscale range when available, otherwise full range.
entries.reason: vector_splice and ConstantRange/vscale analysis are not modeled

entries.description: For a proven zero splice offset, vector_splice_left(A,B,0) returns A and vector_splice_right(A,B,0) returns B.
entries.reason: vector_splice and ConstantRange analysis are not modeled

entries.description: Cancel vp_reverse(vp_reverse(X, mask1, EVL), mask2, EVL) to X when both use the exact same EVL SSA operand; mask operands may differ.
entries.reason: vp_reverse intrinsic semantics are not modeled

entries.description: For vp_reverse(X,mask,EVL), return X unchanged when X is a splat, regardless of mask or EVL.
entries.reason: vp_reverse and vector splat semantics are not modeled

entries.description: For gc.relocate, if either derived pointer or base pointer is undef, return undef of the relocation result type.
entries.reason: GC relocation semantics are not modeled

entries.description: For gc.relocate returning pointer type, a null derived pointer becomes null of the result pointer type; this assumes most collectors preserve null relocation.
entries.reason: GC strategy/relocation semantics are not modeled

entries.description: For other intrinsic calls, derive FP exception behavior and rounding from constrained call metadata (default ignore/nearest-even), then delegate to simplifyIntrinsic by intrinsic ID and return type.
entries.reason: Generic metadata/context adapter and forwarder to the intrinsic-ID simplifier, whose concrete semantic cases are separately inventoried. It has no single additional intrinsic semantics blocker of its own.

entries.description: When target library analysis says a direct callee can constant-fold and every non-metadata argument is a constant, return LLVM ConstantFoldCall result.
entries.reason: LLVM call constant folder and TargetLibraryInfo semantics are not modeled

entries.description: A call through undef or null callee yields poison of call result type, except musttail calls are rejected before this rule.
entries.reason: Call semantics and musttail constraints are not modeled by current rewrite proof semantics

entries.description: If tryConstantFoldCall succeeds, return its folded result.
entries.reason: Simple forwarding of tryConstantFoldCall result; the call-evaluation boundary is inventoried at IS7673.

entries.description: For direct intrinsic callee (after call constant folding fails), invoke simplifyIntrinsic(CallBase) and return any non-null simplification.
entries.reason: Generic forwarding return from simplifyCall to simplifyIntrinsic(CallBase); concrete intrinsic cases are separately inventoried and some are modeled. The broad unsupported label does not identify an independent algebraic rule.

entries.description: For constrained FP call, first return the constant-folded result if tryConstantFoldCall succeeds.
entries.reason: Delegates constrained call evaluation to the external LLVM call constant folder/TargetLibraryInfo; constrained FP environment is an additional semantic dependency.

entries.description: For constrained FP call, return simplifyIntrinsic(CallBase) result when non-null after constant folding fails.
entries.reason: Floating semantics and constrained FP metadata are not modeled

entries.description: Remove freeze(X) and return X when value tracking proves X is neither undef nor poison.
entries.reason: Requires proof-bearing value-tracking facts (known bits / guaranteed non-poison). MatchProg.inspectOperation facts are erased by Models; no such analysis semantics exist.

entries.description: For nonvolatile load from a constant pointer operand, constant-fold the loaded value from that pointer.
entries.reason: LLVM constant-memory load folder is not modeled

entries.description: If underlying object is a constant global with definitive initializer and ConstantFoldLoadFromUniformValue proves initializer uniform for requested load type, return that constant regardless of offset.
entries.reason: Global initializer/uniform memory analysis is not modeled

entries.description: Strip constant offsets through invariant.group while allowing inbounds relaxation; if stripped pointer is the constant global, sign-extend/truncate offset to that address space's index width and constant-fold load from the global initializer.
entries.reason: Pointer offset/provenance and global constant memory analysis are not modeled

entries.description: For any instruction whose NewOps are all constants and which has no explicit simplifier case, constant-fold the instruction operands; otherwise return null.
entries.reason: LLVM generic ConstantFoldInstOperands is not modeled

entries.description: Dispatch FNeg instruction to simplifyFNegInst using instruction fast-math flags.
entries.reason: Simple opcode dispatch to simplifyFNegInst; its concrete constant and double-negation cases are inventoried at IS5932/IS5937.

entries.description: Dispatch FAdd instruction to simplifyFAddInst with instruction fast-math flags.
entries.reason: Simple opcode dispatch to simplifyFAddInst; its concrete cases are inventoried at IS6039-IS6091.

entries.description: Call simplifyInstructionWithOperands on the instruction's current operands; if unreachable-code simplification returns the instruction itself, return poison of its type.
entries.reason: Outer wrapper substitutes poison if a simplifier returns the input instruction itself in unreachable IR. This is a self-result handling policy requiring reachability/context, not a standalone local scalar algebraic rule; scalar poison itself is modeled.
